body.objective: Characterize Weyl gravity FULLY in the reverse-physics sense: for each layer of the theory, which minimal physical assumptions is the layer EQUIVALENT to, with independence witnesses and an honest ledger. Four layers. (1) THE ACTION is done: REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_ACTION_V1 shows S = alpha int sqrt(-g) C^2 is equivalent to five assumptions rather than implied by six, with the derivative order DERIVED from D - 2k = 0 rather than assumed, and RP-PARITY independent on actions but redundant on field equations. (2) THE FIELD EQUATIONS were recorded as never computed by this stream; that was true of the stream and false of the repository, and the layer is now partly discharged (see current_gate). (3) THE GAUGE STRUCTURE. CORRECTED 2026-08-06: this previously read 'UNTOUCHED and the largest genuine hole ... has no independence witness', which is STALE -- it predates diff_independence.py, and anyone starting from it would rebuild what exists. RP-DIFF IS WITNESSED (REVERSE_PHYSICS_DIFF_INDEPENDENCE_V1): on the enlarged carrier at derivative order zero the lowest weight-zero degree is 55-dimensional, entirely Weyl-invariant, with Diff-invariant subspace exactly 0, so all 55 are witnesses -- and the consequence is that the derived derivative order k = D/2 REQUIRES RP-DIFF. The Noether facts N1 (nabla^a B_ab = 0) and N2 (the trace law) are computed, not imported. Substantial BV/BRST machinery exists and has never been cited by this stream: field_bv_identification (an exact chain isomorphism with projector and homotopy), quantum-weyl (~380 files), d_quotient_classical (~150). THE REAL GAPS, each stated by the certificate itself: (a) the witness is one degree deep -- only (2,0), with (3,1), (4,2) unclassified; (b) independence is CONDITIONAL -- the Stuckelberg escape is blocked by RP-METRIC, not refuted, and the entanglement is recorded; (c) THE REVERSE-PHYSICS QUESTION HAS NEVER BEEN ASKED OF THE GAUGE STRUCTURE -- for the action and field equations the stream asked 'what is this equivalent to', but for the gauge layer only 'is RP-DIFF independent', which is strictly weaker. See reverse_physics/reports/gauge-layer-brief.md for the scoped question, the computation, the module-over-functions trap that would overcount it, and the controls. (4) THE SPECTRUM is partial: weyl-ghost-forced.md proves the uniqueness theorem and the ghost theorem are the same theorem, both following from D - 2k = 0; the DYNAMICAL consequence of the ghost is not characterized, and GHOST_MODEL_OBSTRUCTION showed the coprime obstruction does not decide it in either direction. Underneath all four sits the GEOMETRY column, which PHYSICS-VS-MATH.md itself calls 'the bulk of the intellectual content', imported and unverified.

body.current_gate: A PUBLISHED RESULT IS RETRACTED AND TWO COUNTS ARE CORRECTED. READ THIS BEFORE ANY PARITY WORK. REVERSE_PHYSICS_PARITY_SCALAR_CONTROL_V1 (report reverse_physics/reports/parity-scalar-defect.md) establishes that eight of the PARITY-ODD candidates in curvature_invariants_parity_gate were NOT TENSOR CONTRACTIONS. A contraction is covariant only when each repeated index appears once UP and once DOWN; these summed a repeated index over two LOWER or two UPPER slots with no metric between them, which makes the value COORDINATE-DEPENDENT. WHAT IS RETRACTED: REVERSE_PHYSICS_PARITY_FIELD_EQUATIONS_V1 outright. The Lagrangian it differentiated moves under a chart change x = A y with A in SL(6, Z) -- 6566972251/160 in one chart, -200078513393/160 in another -- and that first number is exactly the L(g) it published as its conformal-invariance control. The claim that RP-PARITY is NOT redundant on the D = 6 field equations is WITHDRAWN, and so is the route from it to a dimension-dependent assumption count. The numbers E^00 = -12614421113/320, E^12 = 1224309325271/160 and E^00 = 1290109675603/640 are the Euler-Lagrange expression of a chart-dependent quantity and mean nothing. WHAT IS CORRECTED: REVERSE_PHYSICS_PARITY_CONFORMAL_COUNT_V1, in two of its four rows. Weight-6 parity-odd invariants are 1 in D = 4 (rankV = 4, rankD = 3) and 0 in D = 6 (rankV = 0 and rankD = 0 -- every candidate, algebraic and derivative, Weyl-built and Riemann-built, is identically zero). The D = 4 weight-4 Pontryagin row is UNCHANGED at 1 and the odd-D row is UNCHANGED at none. WHAT SURVIVES UNTOUCHED: the Pontryagin row is the one the ledger's RP-PARITY assumption actually rests on, so REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_ACTION_V1 and the gravitational theta-angle statement are UNAFFECTED. The EULER OPERATOR is unaffected: its n = 6 exercise still returns exactly zero field equations for L = d_0(sqrt|det g|). The instrument was right; the Lagrangian it was pointed at was not. The PARITY-EVEN counts are unaffected -- REVERSE_PHYSICS_CUBIC_CONFORMAL_COUNT_V1 and the derivative-sector count now carry the same chart rail and pass. The exact-arithmetic trick for the Levi-Civita tensor (evaluate where |det g| = 1 so the tensor IS the symbol) is unaffected. WHY THREE SEPARATE GUARDS ALL MISSED IT -- THIS IS THE PART THAT MUST NOT BE FORGOTTEN. (a) THE CONFORMAL TEST IS VACUOUS ON WEYL-BUILT CANDIDATES. It compares g with e^{2 sigma} g at a base point where sigma vanishes. But C^{a}_{bcd} is conformally invariant with NO derivative-of-sigma terms at all, so ANY product of Weyl tensors, contracted in ANY index pattern, passes it automatically. The gate's own comment said the candidates were 'conformally invariant by construction'. That was TRUE, and it is exactly why the test could say nothing. (b) THE WEIGHT COUNT CANCELS: one down-down pair and one up-up pair contribute -2 and +2, so the total weight came out precisely correct. (c) NOTHING EVER ASKED WHETHER A CANDIDATE WAS A TENSOR. The apparatus tested conformal behaviour and never tested covariance. WHERE THE DEFECT LIVES, so the next candidate family is not built the same way: each operand is a SLOT SPEC -- which slots feed the epsilon, which take a contracted index -- and its VARIANCE is implicit in which pre-raised array the spec is handed. cu012 is C^{abc}_{d}; cu01 is C^{ab}_{cd}. Pass the wrong one, or transpose two free slots, and the spec still type-checks, still runs, and still returns a number. THE FALSIFIER, now a permanent rail: change chart by x = A y with A in SL(n, Z), so g'_{ab}(y) = A^k_a A^l_b g_{kl}(A y). A genuine scalar takes the same value at the base point in both charts. det A = 1 keeps the arithmetic exact and preserves |det g| = 1 there, which is what keeps the Levi-Civita SYMBOL equal to the TENSOR and the whole parity-odd sector rational. Three charts: unit lower-triangular, unit upper-triangular, and their PRODUCT, which is triangular in neither direction. CALIBRATED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: R, C_{abcd}C^{abcd} and the PONTRYAGIN DENSITY must transport correctly and Pontryagin must be nonzero, while a deliberately malformed sum_{ab} R_{ab} R_{ab} must MOVE. Without the negative half, 'everything passed' means the test is blind rather than the code correct. ONE NUANCE THAT COST A FALSE ALARM: componentwise diagnostics (ci_comp_sq -- squared components, used deliberately because a contracted norm can vanish on a nonzero tensor under an indefinite metric) are NOT SCALARS BY DESIGN and only their VANISHING is ever read. The rail compares candidates by VALUE and those diagnostics by VANISHING. THE DEFECT WORTH NAMING: D = 6 candidate 9 was ZERO AS WRITTEN, so no wrong number ever pointed at it. It could only be found by asking whether the contraction was well formed -- never by watching output. Repairing it can turn a zero into a nonzero, so it had to be fixed BEFORE 'D = 6 is empty' meant anything. That is the argument for auditing CONSTRUCTION rather than OUTPUT. WHY THE D = 6 ZERO IS STRUCTURAL: the covariant repairs vanish for RIEMANN as well as for Weyl, and Riemann is not traceless, so it is the index PATTERN that is empty rather than the Weyl trace conditions. No choice of curvature tensor rescues it. AN EMPTY SECTOR IS A RESULT, AND THE GATE HAD TO BE REBUILT TO SAY SO. Three of its checks demanded that the candidates be nonzero, that the Weyl-built candidates be nonzero, and that the ranks saturate -- every one a PREMISE OF A NONZERO COUNT, so demanding them would be demanding the wrong answer. Checks 4, 5, 6 and 8 now branch: where the sector is empty they require every candidate to be EXACTLY zero, BOTH RANKS to be zero (stronger than the count being zero, which is a difference and could vanish with both ranks positive), and a PARITY-EVEN WITNESS R_{abcd}R^{abcd} to be nonzero on the same fixtures. Without that witness, 'every parity-odd candidate vanishes' is indistinguishable from a pipeline that returns zero for everything. WHAT REPLACES THE WITHDRAWN CONCLUSION, and it is deliberately WEAKER: with no parity-odd invariant to adjoin, RP-PARITY would be VACUOUS in D = 6 rather than load-bearing -- the OPPOSITE direction from what was published. That is recorded as the reading the evidence favours, NOT as a result: it follows only if the candidate family is complete, and these counts remain LOWER BOUNDS over the patterns evaluated. D = 6 = 0 says THESE patterns vanish, not that no parity-odd conformal invariant exists in six dimensions. ONE THING OBSERVED AND NOT EXPLAINED: in D = 4 the malformed sw1 was chart-INVARIANT across all six comparisons despite not being covariantly formed, presumably a four-dimensional identity. It is repaired regardless. Recorded as an observation. RAILS: curvature_coord_scalar_control_gate 19/19 ASan-clean under forge verify; curvature_invariants_parity_gate 22/22 after repair, with the per-candidate chart audit as checks 21 and 22; curvature_invariants_d6_gate 27/27 and curvature_invariants_deriv_gate 40/40, both with the chart rail added, so BOTH parity-even counts are audited and clean. THE D = 6 GATE AS A WHOLE, restated. PARITY-EVEN, unaffected by any of the above: REVERSE_PHYSICS_CUBIC_CONFORMAL_COUNT_V1 gives 1, 1, 2 across D = 4, 5, 6 with cubic curvature spans 6, 7, 8; REVERSE_PHYSICS_DERIVATIVE_CONFORMAL_COUNT_V1 adds grad R grad R and R grad grad R to reach 2, 2, 3, matching the cited 3 in D = 6 by computation. PARITY-ODD, corrected: 1 in D = 4 at weight 6, 0 in D = 6, 1 for the D = 4 weight-4 Pontryagin density, none in odd dimensions by index counting. THE EXACT-ARITHMETIC AND PERFORMANCE SUBSTRATE IS UNAFFECTED and still stands: metric_inverse, metric_det, jet_sqrt_unit, riemann_const, math/curvinv, math/curvcov, math/levicivita, jet_mul/jet_add with the old ones kept as ORACLES, jet_truncate, jet_var_slice, jet_compose (which the chart rail uses to substitute the linear map), curvature no longer assuming nv == n, and the borrow-taking fmul_ref/fadd_ref that removed the clone-per-multiply. NEXT, in priority order. (1) DECIDE WHETHER THE D = 6 PARITY-ODD SECTOR IS REALLY EMPTY, which needs an argument that the candidate family is complete -- an enumeration of index patterns rather than a hand-built list. Until then the honest statement is a lower bound. (2) AUDIT EVERY OTHER SLOT-SPEC CONSTRUCTION IN THE REPOSITORY for the same defect. The chart rail is cheap and belongs wherever candidates are hand-specified. (3) EXACTNESS for the parity-even sector: box box R would turn the D = 6 lower bound into a count. (4) EXHIBITING A BASIS for the parity-even sector. (5) C-GHOST-DYNAMICS remains the last OPEN row of the comparison ledger, and THE GAUGE LAYER (RP-DIFF, the BRST/BV complex) is still the largest genuine hole in the objective. DISCIPLINE NOTES. The recurring failure this session is CHECKS THAT PASS VACUOUSLY: an epsilon-collapse identity first 'validated' where BOTH SIDES VANISHED; a conformal test that any index pattern passes; a status check that read a fragment of a parse error as success and surfaced only because a twenty-second gate returned in zero seconds. The counter-discipline is a NEGATIVE CONTROL on every rail -- something that must FAIL -- and gates that PRINT which check failed. Mutation testing found an if/else precedence bug dropping the Hessian's factor of 2, a gate whose own expect was miscounted at 16 against 17, a fixture in normal coordinates where Gamma(0) = 0, and a D = 4 fixture with g(base) = delta where raising and lowering coincide. None of those were found by reading the code.
body.stop_condition: EITHER every entry of the GEOMETRY column is discharged or explicitly cited to an existing certificate, the field-equation layer is characterized by variation rather than definition, and the gauge layer has at least one independence witness for RP-DIFF — at which point 'fully characterized' is a defensible claim for three of four layers with the fourth ledgered; OR a layer returns an exact obstruction showing the reverse-physics question is not well posed there, which is itself the deliverable and must be recorded with the same rails.
body.forbid: claiming any geometric fact is PROVED when it is DISCHARGED — the discharge verifies exactly at specific metrics, which is strictly stronger than an unverified import and strictly weaker than a theorem for all metrics, and the certificate must keep saying so in those words; asserting G8's W_pm^2 = (C^2 pm P)/2 without its signature qualification, since the Lorentzian Hodge star squares to -1 on two-forms (local_bv/hodge.py records eigenvalues pm i) so W_pm are complex conjugates there and the decomposition as stated is EUCLIDEAN; reinventing any convention this repository already maintains — three attempts in this stream (Riemann tensor, Bach tensor, action variation) each concluded 'we do not have this' about the STREAM while the REPOSITORY had it, and the fourth (the Hodge dual) produced a wrong normalization; promoting a discharge on a Ricci-flat metric to a statement about the R^2 or Ric^2 coefficients, which VANISH there and cannot be seen; using any certificate in this stream as evidence inside the Weyl classical or quantum chains — the one-way direction is load-bearing and is scanned by REVERSE_PHYSICS_CHAIN_IMPORTS_V1. THE CONVERSE IS NO LONGER FORBIDDEN: citing INTO this stream from the Weyl chains is permitted under four conditions (C1 no cycles, C2 tags travel, C3 pinned and fail-closed, C4 middle column only), because circularity requires a cycle and the dependency has always been one-way, while tag laundering is prevented by carrying the boundary rather than by refusing to cite. Stating a claim here at a dependency tag its imports do not support IS forbidden, and is checked mechanically; treating the coprime/ghost toy-model results as statements about Weyl gravity, which they explicitly are not.
